$comment: Head of an independent review event log (docs/dev/independent-review-spec.md section 3), review_head.json next to review_log.jsonl, rewritten by the author agent after every append under the log lock: count is the number of events, last_sha256 the canonical SHA-256 (contracts.revocation.canonical_sha256) of the last event. contracts/review.py verify_log trusts a log only with a head that matches it.
